title: Great experience!
text: This was a fantastic experience! I didn’t know much about jamon before and we both learned a lot about the different breeds of pigs and the quality of the meat. Juan was an excellent teacher and made the tasting fun and interesting.
author: musicmom

title: More than a jamon tasting - but a complete experience!
text: Juan is the jamon master! You leave with a head filled with facts and a satisfied tummy. A fun and informative experience. You don't have to be a foodie to enjoy this tour. Highly recommend this experience,
author: Wendy_F

title: Excellent Tasting!!!
text:
Excellent class on The class on Iberian ham was simply excellent. A great, unrivalled and truly sublime experience. I learned to differentiate the different flavors, nuances and qualities, something that undoubtedly enriches the way to enjoy this product.
DIEGO’s masterclass was impeccable: he explained everything with clarity, passion and a deep knowledge about Iberian ham, from its origin to the tasting. 
You can see the dedication and love for what he does.
Without a doubt, a highly recommended experience for those who want to learn and live Iberian ham in a unique way.
author: Flavio Adrian V

title: Best learning experience
text:
I have learnt a lot through this experience class, and I know more about the Jamon pairing with wine. 
Cintia run the class and she has taught a lot and make sure I understand the process and details. It is very interesting to join this class!
author: WaiShan_C

title: More like an educational tasting
text:
Being titled a “masterclass,” we would have liked more audio-visual presentation (such as cutting demonstrations) or other more hands-on experiences.

However, there was definitely lots of Jamon to taste and our instructor was very informative and friendly. It was a very good & interesting tasting. Also plenty of cava.
author: Andrea_L
